create_calico_installation enables Calico as the EKS CNI, but can race delete_daemonset. Order it after removal of the competing aws-node CNI daemonset so that the two CNI configurations are not activated concurrently.

The Karpenter Helm deployment requires working pod networking. Its current path waits only for the Tigera operator manifest, not for creation of the Calico Installation that configures the replacement CNI. Depend on create_calico_installation before deploying the controller; additionally ensure Calico readiness because kubectl create alone does not wait for reconciliation.
